daily.brief: 過去約29.5小時（11月24日凌晨3:30至25日上午9:05）151個帳號發了401則帖。共同看好最集中的是$DELL的AI訂單積壓超過去年全年銷售額，以及$HPE業績超預期上調指引；共同看淡則是$AMBA因記憶體價格暴漲客戶下調展望而盤後大跌，以及$ADI單日大跌。最熱鬧的$NVDA有124則提及，多空帳號20對6。
daily.full:
共識

共同看好以AI伺服器與部分成長名稱為主。$DELL有8個帳號同向：@JohnSpall247轉推指出Dell現有待完成的AI訂單超過其去年全部銷售額，客戶已訂購1320億美元尚未出貨的AI伺服器，較一年前的180億美元增加（原帖）；@tenet_research分享財報電話會議，傳統伺服器單位下降但收入增長235%，代理AI推動需求，預期2027年供應短缺惡化（原帖）；@JonahLupton說在-50%回調後的爆炸性報告上漲不到2%是瘋狂的（原帖）。$HPE有4個：@tenet_research分享業績回顧，收入14.55B同比+50%，非GAAP EPS 1.43，營運現金流2.3B（原帖）；@danielnewmanUV指出所有指標超預期並上調指引，強勁網絡與AI伺服器需求，沒有neocloud信貸敞口，專注企業交易（原帖）。$AMD有4個，@canuck2usa說回撤時買入，較高點低約39%，現在要守住395美元區域（原帖）。

共同看淡

$AMBA有5個帳號看淡。@carlquintanilla轉推Ambarella CEO稱先前強調的記憶體價格前所未有的上漲及供應稀缺已加劇，導致許多客戶降低展望，盤後-37%（原帖）；@moninvestor提到財報前下跌19.96%，結果公布後盤後又下跌43.11%（原帖）。$ADI有3個，@MikeZaccardi指出-17.4%，自1998年以來最差的一天（原帖）；@Ross__Hendricks提醒注意引用低遠期PE倍數的多頭，半導體削減已開始（原帖）。$ORCL有2個，@Mayhem4Markets引用信貸開始看起來完全混亂，三周前發行的29年債券現在更寬，CDS爆出（原帖）；@PauloMacro說信貸今天完全混亂，曲線上寬20-30，30年紙現在近390以上（原帖）。

分歧

分歧最大的是$NVDA，124則提及中多空帳號20對6。@GerberKawasaki表示即使使用新公式折扣所有事務及各種可能風險，在Jensen領導下其Nvidia晶片AI分析得出每股242美元（原帖）；@KobeissiLetter報導特朗普總統稱願意在如有必要時赦免黃仁勳，全力支持（原帖）。@CheddarFlow提到有人買入310萬美元的$MU看漲期權並繼續增加半導體看漲期權包括$AMD $NVDA $SOXL（原帖）。$MU多空4對3，@TradexWhisperer說75%售罄，談判轉向2028，$SKHY超過50%在LTA下簽署，實際上售罄至2029（原帖）。$TSLA1對3，@garyblack00說等到$SPCX價格跌至每股100美元以下再考慮，以TSLA +25%溢價估計（原帖），但@GerberKawasaki擔心SpaceX即將用大量特斯拉股票稀釋其所有者（原帖）。

其他值得留意

$LLY有3個帳號看好，@MikeZaccardi形容它繼續像會治癒癌症一樣交易，市值接近超大型AI股票（原帖）。記憶體與AI伺服器討論持續，部分帳號關注供應短缺與訂單積壓。

daily.brief: Over roughly the last 29.5 hours (3:30 on Nov 24 to 9:05 on Nov 25), 151 accounts posted 401 times. Shared bullish views concentrated on $DELL AI order backlog exceeding last year's full sales and $HPE earnings beat with raised guidance; shared bearish focused on $AMBA customers cutting outlook due to memory price spikes and after-hours plunge, plus $ADI sharp single-day drop. The busiest name $NVDA had 124 mentions with 20 bullish versus 6 bearish accounts.
daily.full:
Consensus

Shared bullish views centered on AI servers and selected growth names. $DELL had 8 accounts aligned: @JohnSpall247 noted Dell's pending AI orders exceed last year's total sales, with customers having ordered $132 billion of unshipped AI servers versus $18 billion a year earlier (post); @tenet_research shared the earnings call where traditional server units declined but revenue grew 235%, agentic AI driving demand and 2027 supply shortages expected to worsen (post); @JonahLupton said the explosive report after a -50% pullback rising less than 2% is crazy (post). $HPE had 4: @tenet_research shared the earnings recap with revenue of $14.55B up 50% YoY, non-GAAP EPS $1.43, and operating cash flow of $2.3B (post); @danielnewmanUV noted beats across all metrics and raised guidance on strong networking and AI server demand, with no neocloud credit exposure and a focus on enterprise deals (post). $AMD had 4; @canuck2usa said buy the dip, about 39% off the high, and the job now is to hold the $395 area (post).

Shared Bearish

$AMBA had 5 bearish accounts. @carlquintanilla shared the Ambarella CEO stating the previously highlighted unprecedented memory price surge and supply scarcity has intensified, causing many customers to lower outlooks, after-hours -37% (post); @moninvestor noted the stock fell 19.96% before the report and another 43.11% after-hours following results (post). $ADI had 3; @MikeZaccardi pointed to -17.4%, the worst day since 1998 (post); @Ross__Hendricks warned about bulls citing low forward PE multiples as semiconductor cuts have begun (post). $ORCL had 2; @Mayhem4Markets cited credit starting to look completely messy, with the 29-year bond issued three weeks ago now wider and CDS blowing out (post); @PauloMacro said credit was completely messy today, 20-30 wider on the curve, and the 30-year paper now near 390+ (post).

Split

The largest split was on $NVDA, with 20 bullish versus 6 bearish accounts among 124 mentions. @GerberKawasaki said even using the new formula discounting all matters and various possible risks, under Jensen's leadership the Nvidia chip AI analysis comes to $242 per share (post); @KobeissiLetter reported President Trump saying he is willing to pardon Jensen Huang if necessary and fully supports him (post). @CheddarFlow mentioned someone buying $3.1 million of $MU call options and continuing to add semiconductor calls including $AMD $NVDA $SOXL (post). $MU was 4 versus 3; @TradexWhisperer said 75% sold out with negotiations shifting to 2028, $SKHY over 50% signed under LTA and effectively sold out to 2029 (post). $TSLA was 1 versus 3; @garyblack00 said wait until $SPCX falls below $100 per share, estimated at TSLA +25% premium (post), while @GerberKawasaki worried SpaceX is about to dilute Tesla owners with a large amount of Tesla stock (post).

Other Notable

$LLY had 3 bullish accounts; @MikeZaccardi described it continuing to trade like it will cure cancer, approaching mega AI stocks in market cap (post). Memory and AI server discussions continue, with some accounts focusing on supply shortages and order backlogs.

briefing.html:
Today's Briefing

Over roughly the last 29.5 hours, 151 accounts posted 401 times. AI server names like DELL saw strong shared bullish views with order backlog exceeding last year's full sales at $132 billion; HPE beat and raised guidance while emphasizing no neocloud credit exposure. AMBA plunged after-hours as memory price spikes caused customers to cut outlooks, and ADI had its worst single-day drop since 1998. NVDA led with 124 mentions and a 20-versus-6 split; one side cited a $242 target and Trump support while others watched valuation and options flow. AMD had someone noting the need to hold the $395 area. All numbers come from the specified period's calculated results.
